appearance: The three translucent layers remain, with original Gaiden e_n_5001_hitsmoke_small providing the narrow middle wisp and e_f_d0004_spark providing alternating fine flying sparks. Existing Yakuza 6 animated smoke/flame and small Kiwami 2 impact shapes remain. All pixels retain native dimensions; no generated artwork. Particle budgets, brief histories, colour and bounded swirls are retained.
tracking: Native bone-to-world coordinates omit the character camera translation in Core.DoPushIsoStuff. WorldEffects.modelOffsetY adds the missing .48*.61237234*96*tileScale only in sprite screen offsets, preserving world depth. This applies to limb coats, source-derived sparks, charging limbs and explicitly marked model-bone Heat Action/blood anchors; ordinary authored world anchors remain unchanged. Active coating uses proportional native track weight instead of the erroneous 70-percent visibility cutoff. Recovery-only smoke still drops when its old track fades. Baked curves remain subject to actual engine blending differences; this is not live blended-bone access.
